column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah sisi E99005: Florence menolong dua prajurit Mangi Security.
# Tetap Inggris: Florence, Colphne, Springfield, Centaureissi, Mayling, Vasily, Lindy,
# Squad 404, The Elmo, Mokosh, Mangi Security, PA-15, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud,
# IFF, Yellow Zone.
# Catatan: dua baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin — isinya persis sama
# dengan dua kalimat Komandan di naskah E99004, jadi diterjemahkan sama persis.
Mokosh's doctor has already performed emergency treatment on the Commander according to the instructions you left.
column2: Dokter Mokosh sudah memberi penanganan darurat pada Komandan sesuai instruksi yang kautinggalkan.

column1: Now his vital signs are very stable.
column2: Sekarang tanda vitalnya sangat stabil.

column1: However, to be safe, we have finished discussing it with Vasily.
column2: Tapi untuk amannya, kami sudah selesai membahasnya dengan Vasily.

column1: Next, Squad 404 will execute the breakout plan and safely escort the Commander back to The Elmo.
column2: Berikutnya, Squad 404 akan menjalankan rencana terobosan dan mengawal Komandan pulang dengan selamat ke Elmo.

column1: As for follow-up treatment, just leave it to little Colphne to judge. Springfield and Centaureissi know how to execute this special care plan I drafted.
column2: Soal perawatan lanjutannya, serahkan saja pada penilaian Colphne kecil. Springfield dan Centaureissi tahu cara menjalankan rencana perawatan khusus yang kususun ini.

column1: Understood. Aren't you breaking out and evacuating with us?
column2: Dimengerti. Kau tidak menerobos dan menyingkir bersama kami?

column1: I'm the frontline rescue captain~ How can I just leave casually.
column2: Aku ini kapten tim penyelamat garis depan~ Mana bisa aku pergi begitu saja.

column1: I understand. Stay safe.
column2: Aku mengerti. Jaga keselamatanmu.

column1: Phew... hurts hurts hurts...
column2: Fiuh... sakit sakit sakit...

column1: I didn't expect the tactile parameters adjusted to pursue surgical precision would cause such a high burden on the Neural cloud at a time like this.
column2: Tak kusangka parameter peraba yang kusetel demi mengejar presisi bedah justru membebani Neural cloud sebesar ini di saat seperti sekarang.

column1: I have no idea how little Lindy managed to endure with that kind of Frame and Neural cloud...
column2: Aku sama sekali tidak tahu bagaimana Lindy kecil bisa bertahan dengan Frame dan Neural cloud semacam itu...

column1: Looking this tattered... performing surgery on the Commander, even I couldn't handle something this stimulating.
column2: Dengan tampang serombeng ini... mengoperasi Komandan, sensasi sebesar itu bahkan aku pun tak sanggup.

column1: (Florence lowers her eyes, her gaze sweeping over her dilapidated Frame. Her abdomen bears a terrifying penetrating wound left by an armor-piercing round specialized for Dolls. The joint of her right arm emits a hissing cry of distress, occasionally sparking with blinding electrical arcs.)
column2: (Florence menunduk, pandangannya menyapu Frame-nya yang sudah rombeng. Di perutnya menganga luka tembus mengerikan bekas peluru penembus lapis baja khusus anti-Doll. Sendi lengan kanannya mengeluarkan desis rintihan, sesekali memercikkan busur listrik yang menyilaukan.)

column1: (In order to snatch more lives from this cruel meat grinder, this is already the tenth medical-specialized Frame she has prepared, and the final one.)
column2: (Demi merebut lebih banyak nyawa dari mesin penggiling daging yang kejam ini, ini sudah Frame khusus medis kesepuluh yang dia siapkan, sekaligus yang terakhir.)

column1: Blown to pieces by suicide drones, decapitated by third-generation Dolls, riddled with bullets by heavy machine guns... Thanks to Mayling and Vasily's new system, I was able to gain so many fresh experiences while retaining my memories.
column2: Hancur berkeping oleh drone bunuh diri, dipenggal Doll generasi ketiga, dibolongi peluru senapan mesin berat... Berkat sistem baru Mayling dan Vasily, aku bisa mendapat begitu banyak pengalaman segar sambil tetap menyimpan ingatanku.

column1: It's just a pity that my carefully maintained exclusive frames were all ruined. This time, I'll have to leave the headache of treating the Commander to little Colphne.
column2: Sayangnya frame eksklusifku yang kurawat baik-baik hancur semua. Kali ini, urusan merepotkan merawat Komandan terpaksa kuserahkan pada Colphne kecil.

column1: Oh well, after this is over, I definitely have to find an excuse to properly touch the Commander's body and make up for it with interest~
column2: Ya sudahlah, setelah semua ini selesai, aku harus mencari alasan untuk memeriksa tubuh Komandan baik-baik dan menebusnya berikut bunganya~

column1: But the problem now is that the stupid dragon ruined my planned safe evacuation route with what it did earlier. How am I supposed to sneak back into Mokosh...? Hmm?
column2: Tapi masalahnya sekarang, naga bodoh itu merusak rute evakuasi aman yang sudah kurencanakan lewat ulahnya tadi. Bagaimana caraku menyelinap kembali ke Mokosh...? Hmm?

column1: Save...
column2: Tolong...

column1: It sounds like... human voices?
column2: Kedengarannya seperti... suara manusia?

column1: Is anyone there... whoever it is... save... us...
column2: Ada orang di sana... siapa pun... tolong... kami...

column1: Use the hardest thing you have to hit any object near you! I'll follow the sound to find you!
column2: Pakai benda paling keras yang kaupunya untuk memukul apa saja di dekatmu! Aku akan mengikuti suaranya untuk menemukanmu!

column1: (Tap tap tap... tap—tap—tap—... tap tap tap.)
column2: (Tuk tuk tuk... tuuk—tuuk—tuuk—... tuk tuk tuk.)

column1: (The crisp sound of metal tapping pieced together the internationally recognized SOS signal, allowing Florence to quickly locate the direction.)
column2: (Bunyi nyaring ketukan logam itu merangkai sinyal SOS yang dikenal secara internasional, sehingga Florence cepat menemukan arahnya.)

column1: (She dragged her damaged body forward and tried her best to lift a heavy piece of concrete load-bearing wall rubble.)
column2: (Dia menyeret tubuhnya yang rusak ke depan dan berusaha sekuat tenaga mengangkat sebongkah puing dinding penopang beton yang berat.)

column1: (However, when the face of the person calling for help appeared in the shadows, the atmosphere instantly dropped to freezing point.)
column2: (Namun saat wajah orang yang meminta tolong itu muncul dari bayangan, suasananya seketika membeku.)

column1: Oh my, oh my, this is truly an unexpected twist of fate...
column2: Aduh, aduh, ini benar-benar belokan takdir yang tak terduga...

column1: Eek—it's, it's a Doll!
column2: Iih—itu, itu Doll!

column1: You... you are... the one in the files... PA-15... that devil!
column2: Kau... kau itu... yang ada di berkas... PA-15... si iblis itu!

column1: (In the darkness, a dark assault rifle was shakily raised, its muzzle aimed dead at Florence's glabella.)
column2: (Dalam kegelapan, sepucuk senapan serbu gelap terangkat gemetar, moncongnya membidik tepat ke dahi Florence.)

column1: (The soldier holding the gun wore the standard combat uniform of the enemy faction, 'Mangi Security', with panic and despair written all over her face. And at her feet, another soldier was weakly twitching in a pool of blood.)
column2: (Prajurit yang memegang senjata itu mengenakan seragam tempur standar faksi musuh, 'Mangi Security', dengan panik dan putus asa terbaca jelas di wajahnya. Dan di kakinya, seorang prajurit lain berkedut lemah di genangan darah.)

column1: D-Don't come over! Get back!
column2: J-Jangan mendekat! Mundur!

column1: One conscious recruit, one dying patient... no, are both of them recruits who just went to the battlefield?
column2: Satu rekrutan yang masih sadar, satu pasien sekarat... bukan, apa keduanya rekrutan yang baru turun ke medan tempur?

column1: Mhm, fully thinking what was dug out was a comrade, but it turned out to be an enemy.
column2: Mhm, kukira yang kugali keluar itu rekan sendiri, ternyata musuh.

column1: What should we do now~
column2: Sekarang bagaimana ya~

column1: 虽然你平日里经常恶作剧，行事百无禁忌，但是在医疗上，你永远对生命保持着最纯粹的尊重。
column2: Meski di hari biasa kau sering iseng dan bertindak tanpa pantangan, dalam urusan pengobatan kau selalu menjaga rasa hormat yang paling murni pada kehidupan.

column1: 所以在这一点上，我对你无条件信任。
column2: Jadi soal itu, aku memercayaimu tanpa syarat.

column1: Hehe... put your heart in your stomach, I never lay a hand on stray dogs that have already lost their will to fight. After all, no matter what, I'm still a doctor.
column2: Hehe... tenangkan hatimu, aku tidak pernah menyentuh anjing liar yang sudah kehilangan kehendak bertarung. Lagi pula, bagaimanapun juga aku ini dokter.

column1: Doctor? Are you kidding... us falling to this state... is a-all your fault...
column2: Dokter? Bercanda ya... kami jatuh sampai seperti ini... s-semuanya salah kalian...

column1: You obviously already have my data, so you should know what I used to do, right?
column2: Kalian jelas sudah punya dataku, jadi kalian pasti tahu dulu aku kerja apa, kan?

column1: If you insist on stubbornly holding up that firestick and refuse to believe me, then I'll be forced to defend myself.
column2: Kalau kau bersikeras mengacungkan pentungan api itu dan menolak memercayaiku, aku terpaksa membela diri.

column1: I guarantee, my bullets are absolutely faster and more accurate than your speed of pulling the trigger. That way, it'll be the end for you and your pitiful companion.
column2: Kujamin, peluruku jelas lebih cepat dan lebih akurat daripada kecepatanmu menarik pelatuk. Dengan begitu, tamatlah kau dan rekanmu yang malang itu.

column1: You have ten seconds to think about it. 10... 9... Hehe, what a good boy.
column2: Kau punya sepuluh detik untuk memikirkannya. 10... 9... Hehe, anak baik.

column1: (Hearing the crisp sound of the rifle falling on the rubble, and seeing the Mangi Security soldier dejectedly let go of his weapon, Florence finally put away her gun in satisfaction and stepped forward carrying her battered medical kit.)
column2: (Mendengar bunyi nyaring senapan yang jatuh ke puing, dan melihat prajurit Mangi Security itu melepaskan senjatanya dengan lesu, Florence akhirnya menyimpan senjatanya dengan puas dan melangkah maju sambil menenteng kotak medisnya yang penyok.)

column1: Head hit by a blunt object, right arm ulna fractured... tch, didn't your Mangi Security even teach you the most basic battlefield self-rescue and comrade bandaging?
column2: Kepala terhantam benda tumpul, tulang hasta lengan kanan patah... cih, Mangi Security kalian bahkan tidak mengajari pertolongan diri di medan tempur dan cara membalut rekan yang paling dasar?

column1: No... in our recruit training camp... every day they only teach us how to deal with you tactical Dolls...
column2: Tidak... di kamp latihan rekrutan kami... tiap hari mereka cuma mengajari cara menghadapi kalian para Doll taktis...

column1: And to remember... the Doll data recorded in the files...
column2: Dan menghafal... data Doll yang tercatat di berkas...

column1: Oh my, I've become a celebrity~
column2: Aduh, aku jadi selebritas rupanya~

column1: But before continuing this topic... lend a hand first. Fix her head properly, don't compress the trachea.
column2: Tapi sebelum melanjutkan obrolan ini... bantu dulu. Tahan kepalanya dengan benar, jangan menekan tenggorokannya.

column1: Is she... okay...
column2: Dia... baik-baik saja...

column1: Don't worry, she won't die. It's just a shock coma caused by a severe concussion and intense pain.
column2: Tenang, dia tidak akan mati. Itu cuma koma akibat syok karena gegar otak berat dan nyeri hebat.

column1: Are you relatives? Or friends.
column2: Kalian keluarga? Atau teman.

column1: We're sisters...
column2: Kami kakak beradik...

column1: I'll help her with neck fixation and emergency hemostasis first... Speaking of which, how did you get buried alive in your own people's position?
column2: Aku akan membantu memasang penahan leher dan menghentikan pendarahannya dulu... Ngomong-ngomong, bagaimana kalian bisa terkubur hidup-hidup di posisi pihak kalian sendiri?

column1: It's all because of that damn dragon... tch... you demons!
column2: Semua gara-gara naga sialan itu... cih... dasar iblis kalian!

column1: Let me state in advance, that giant dragon with terrible taste flew over from your camp.
column2: Kutegaskan dari awal, naga raksasa berselera buruk itu terbang dari kemah kalian.

column1: Your sister is fine now. But she needs to rest.
column2: Kakakmu sekarang baik-baik saja. Tapi dia butuh istirahat.

column1: Mhm... I'll also simply bandage your wound for you.
column2: Mhm... lukamu juga akan kubalut seadanya.

column1: Why... save us.
column2: Kenapa... menolong kami.

column1: Hmm~~~~ This question is hard to answer. Just consider it a blessing from an angel in white~
column2: Hmm~~~~ Pertanyaan itu susah dijawab. Anggap saja berkah dari malaikat berjubah putih~

column1: Next, please leave this battlefield on your own... But if you appear on the battlefield again and try to raise your guns against Mokosh, next time, I promise to make your departure completely painless.
column2: Selanjutnya, tolong tinggalkan medan tempur ini dengan kaki kalian sendiri... Tapi kalau kalian muncul lagi di medan tempur dan mencoba mengangkat senjata melawan Mokosh, lain kali kujamin kepergian kalian akan sama sekali tanpa rasa sakit.

column1: (With a 'click', Florence elegantly fastened the latch of her first aid kit and stroked the sidearm at her waist with a slight hint of threat.)
column2: (Dengan bunyi 'klik', Florence dengan anggun mengunci kotak P3K-nya dan mengusap pistol di pinggangnya dengan sedikit nada mengancam.)

column1: Rather than an angel in white, you're more like a devil in white...
column2: Alih-alih malaikat berjubah putih, kau lebih mirip iblis berjubah putih...

column1: I understand, we will leave and absolutely won't come back... We've had enough of this kind of thing too.
column2: Aku mengerti, kami akan pergi dan sama sekali tidak akan kembali... Kami juga sudah muak dengan hal semacam ini.

column1: We originally joined Mangi Security... for the vaccine anyway.
column2: Kami masuk Mangi Security... memang demi vaksinnya.

column1: As expected, this world... has no place to accommodate us displaced people in the Yellow Zone.
column2: Ternyata memang benar, dunia ini... tidak punya tempat untuk menampung kami yang terlunta-lunta di Yellow Zone.

column1: Mhm—there will be, just not now...
column2: Mhm—akan ada, cuma bukan sekarang...

column1: Oh right~ As a private doctor, let me reasonably collect the "consultation fee" for this time first.
column2: Oh iya~ Sebagai dokter swasta, izinkan aku menagih "biaya konsultasi" kali ini secara wajar dulu.

column1: Hmm... let me look... oh, found it, found it.
column2: Hmm... coba kulihat... oh, ketemu, ketemu.

column1: I'll reluctantly borrow the IFF system on your comrade's body.
column2: Dengan berat hati aku akan meminjam sistem IFF di tubuh rekanmu.

column1: Oh right, hand over your squad's deployment map and encrypted communication terminal along the way too.
column2: Oh iya, serahkan sekalian peta penempatan regu kalian dan terminal komunikasi terenkripsinya.

column1: ...How can I do that... this is a violation of military discipline!
column2: ...Mana bisa begitu... ini pelanggaran disiplin militer!

column1: Oh my? Weren't you preparing to leave anyway~
column2: Aduh? Bukankah kalian memang bersiap pergi~

column1: Will you obediently take it off and hand it to me, or wait for me to do it myself and strip it from your warm corpse?
column2: Kau mau melepasnya baik-baik dan menyerahkannya padaku, atau menunggu aku sendiri yang melucutinya dari mayatmu yang masih hangat?

column1: You... you guy... you really are a demon in white skin!
column2: Kau... dasar kau... kau benar-benar iblis berkulit putih!
